formulas.formula: Plan both parties, split costs fairly, and keep the fun stress-free.
Setup: the bride's name, both dates, both budgets, and whether the bride goes free.
Budget: list each cost and pick Shower or Bachelorette. Tick Split for costs the group shares.
Split: everyone going and the cash they gave the organizer. Vendors they paid directly are credited from the Budget's Paid by column.
Shower Guests: RSVPs, gifts and thank-you notes.
Itinerary and Checklist: plan the weekend and stay on track.
Pick Yes and her share is split among everyone else.
Gifts for the bride or things one person treats are not split.
Ask for a deposit when you book. It makes the end easier.
The bride will thank you when she writes her cards.
=IF(R7>0,R7&IF(R7=1," task is"," tasks are")&" overdue on the Checklist.",IF(R4>0,"Collect "&TEXT(R4,"$#,##0")&" from the group for the bachelorette.","Everything is on track. Time to celebrate!"))

=IF(AND('Setup'!$R$6>0,'Budget'!$I$36>'Setup'!$R$6),"Shower is over budget by "&TEXT('Budget'!$I$36-'Setup'!$R$6,"$#,##0")&". ","")&IF(AND('Setup'!$R$9>0,'Budget'!$I$37>'Setup'!$R$9),"Bachelorette is over budget by "&TEXT('Budget'!$I$37-'Setup'!$R$9,"$#,##0")&".","")
Yes = her share is split by the group.
Cost uses the actual price once you have it. Tick Split for bachelorette costs everyone shares.
Minus amounts = the organizer owes that person back.

=COUNTIF('Shower Guests'!$K$6:$K$85,1)&" coming, "&COUNTIF('Shower Guests'!$K$6:$K$85,3)+COUNTIF('Shower Guests'!$K$6:$K$85,4)&" not sure, "&COUNTIF('Shower Guests'!$K$6:$K$85,2)&" can't make it. "&SUM('Shower Guests'!$L$6:$L$85)&" thank-you notes to write."
Dates count back from each party. Tick Done as you go.
Set the date & budget with the family
Book the venue (or host at home)
Pick the place & dates with the bride
Collect the rest of the money
